in_sanskrit.name: अवनिष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Awnish is derived from the Sanskrit word अवनिष (avaniṣ), which means 'Goddess of the Earth'. This name is often used to honor the divine feminine energy of the earth, which is believed to nurture and sustain all living beings.

in_hindi.name: अवनिष
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Awnish in Hindi is written as अवनिष (avaniṣ). It is derived from the Sanskrit word अवनिष (avaniṣ), which means 'Goddess of the Earth'. In Hindi, this name is often translated as 'Invincible Earth', reflecting the power and strength of the earth as a divine force.

in_tamil.name: அவநிஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Awnish in Tamil is written as அவநிஷ (avaniṣ). It is derived from the Sanskrit word अवनिष (avaniṣ), which means 'Goddess of the Earth'. In Tamil, this name is often translated as 'Conscious Earth', reflecting the belief that the earth is not just a physical entity, but a living, conscious being that supports and nurtures all life.

in_telugu.name: అవనిష్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Awnish in Telugu is written as అవనిష్ (avaniṣ). It is derived from the Sanskrit word अवनिष (avaniṣ), which means 'Goddess of the Earth'. In Telugu, this name is often translated as 'Invincible Goddess', reflecting the power and strength of the earth as a divine force.
